verdict.rationale: ScrapingBee supports passing custom `cookies` per request and a `session_id` to route repeated requests through the same IP, which offers some session continuity, but there is no documented persistent browser profile that automatically stores and reuses login state/cookies across calls — cookies must be manually supplied each time. Missing for 10: explicit persistent profile/session storage feature, first-party docs on retaining login state across requests, and independent confirmation of session/cookie persistence working end-to-end.
